apiPrerequisites: Discover exact served v1 GVR, installed schema and separate CRUD authorization. No optional controller or feature gate is required by this pinned baseline. Other versions retain source fallback.

sharedBoundaries.identity: Host owns metadata.name during create and locks identity/revision during edit. Both resources are Cluster scoped; no namespace control.
sharedBoundaries.source: Host owns canonical AST, source preference, privacy, authorization, submission and review. Forms send scoped atomic patches; they never serialize projected parent objects.
sharedBoundaries.status: status.conditions[].{type,status,reason,message,lastTransitionTime} are inspect-only, with no status ownership or fabricated health.
sharedBoundaries.permissions: Discovery and schema do not grant create/update verbs. Host enforces capabilities; provider does not synthesize authorization.
sharedBoundaries.ownership: Pinned mandatory and suggested names are exact. Explicit trusted controller/system ownership and controller ownerReferences make custom objects inspect-only. Missing ownership context is not described as proven administrator ownership. Suggested objects require explicit string false opt-out before edit. Mandatory FlowSchemas and catch-all priority are fixed; exempt priority exposes only allowed tuning. Custom policy cannot opt into bootstrap auto-update.
sharedBoundaries.safety: Partial invalid numbers, names, sets, URLs and queue bounds stay local. Unsupported shapes retain source fallback. Changing a union with unknown children refuses destructive replacement. Unknown siblings/comments/exact integers remain canonical. Reference errors contain no returned bodies. No actions, companion objects or live mutation service are invented.
